verses.sa: नमस्ते रुद्र मन्यव उतो त इषवे नमः। बाहुभ्यामुत ते नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste rudra manyava uto ta iṣave namaḥ bāhubhyāmuta te namaḥ
verses.en: Homage be paid unto thy wrath, O Rudra, homage to thy shaft: to thy two arms be homage paid.

verses.sa: या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूरघोराऽपापकाशिनी। तया नस्तन्वा शन्तमया गिरिशन्ताभि चाकशीहि॥
verses.tr: yā te rudra śivā tanūraghorā'pāpakāśinī tayā nastanvā śantamayā giriśantābhi cākaśīhi
verses.en: With that auspicious form of thine, mild, Rudra! pleasant to behold, Even with that most blessed form, look, Mountain-haunter! here on us.

verses.sa: यामिषुं गिरिशन्त हस्ते बिभर्ष्यस्तवे। शिवां गिरित्र तां कुरु मा हिंसीः पुरुषं जगत्॥
verses.tr: yāmiṣuṃ giriśanta haste bibharṣyastave śivāṃ giritra tāṃ kuru mā hiṃsīḥ puruṣaṃ jagat
verses.en: The shaft which, Mountain-haunter, thou art holding in thy hand to shoot. Make that auspicious, Mountain-Lord! Injure not man nor moving thing.

verses.sa: शिवेन वचसा त्वा गिरिशाच्छा वदामसि। यथा नः सर्वमिज्जगदयक्ष्मं सुमना असत्॥
verses.tr: śivena vacasā tvā giriśācchā vadāmasi yathā naḥ sarvamijjagadayakṣmaṃ sumanā asat
verses.en: O Dweller on the Mountain, we salute thee with auspicious hymn; That all, yea, all our people may be healthy and well-satisfied.

verses.sa: अध्यवोचदधिवक्ता प्रथमो दैव्यो भिषक्। अहीँश्च सर्वाञ्जम्भयन्त्सर्वाश्च यातुधान्योऽधराचीः परा सुव॥
verses.tr: adhyavocadadhivaktā prathamo daivyo bhiṣak ahīṃśca sarvāñjambhayantsarvāśca yātudhānyo'dharācīḥ parā suva
verses.en: The Advocate, the first divine Physician, hath defended us. Crushing all serpents, drive away all Yattjdhinis down below.

verses.sa: असौ यस्ताम्रो अरुण उत बभ्रुः सुमङ्गलः। ये चैनं रुद्रा अभितो दिक्षु श्रिताः सहस्रशोऽवैषां हेड ईमहे॥
verses.tr: asau yastāmro aruṇa uta babhruḥ sumaṅgalaḥ ye cainaṃ rudrā abhito dikṣu śritāḥ sahasraśo'vaiṣāṃ heḍa īmahe
verses.en: That most auspicious One whose hue is coppery and red and brown, And those, the Rudras who maintain their station in the regions, who surround him in a thousand bands, of these we deprecate the wrath.

verses.sa: असौ योऽवसर्पति नीलग्रीवो विलोहितः। उतैनं गोपा अदृश्रन्नदृश्रन्नुदहार्यः स दृष्टो मृडयाति नः॥
verses.tr: asau yo'vasarpati nīlagrīvo vilohitaḥ utainaṃ gopā adṛśrannadṛśrannudahāryaḥ sa dṛṣṭo mṛḍayāti naḥ
verses.en: May he who glides away, whose neck is azure, and whose hue is red. He whom the herdsmen, whom the girls who carry water have beheld, may he when seen be kind to us.

verses.sa: नमोऽस्तु नीलग्रीवाय सहस्राक्षाय मीढुषे। अथो ये अस्य सत्वानोऽहं तेभ्योऽकरं नमः॥
verses.tr: namo'stu nīlagrīvāya sahasrākṣāya mīḍhuṣe atho ye asya satvāno'haṃ tebhyo'karaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to him the Azure-necked, the thousand-eyed, the bountiful, Yea, and his spirit ministers-to them I offer reverence.

verses.sa: प्रमुञ्च धन्वनस्त्वमुभयोरार्त्न्योर्ज्याम्। याश्च ते हस्त इषवः परा ता भगवो वप॥
verses.tr: pramuñca dhanvanastvamubhayorārtnyorjyām yāśca te hasta iṣavaḥ parā tā bhagavo vapa
verses.en: Loosen thy bowstring, loosen it from thy bow's two extremities, And cast away, O Lord Divine, the arrows that are in thy hand.

verses.sa: विज्यं धनुः कपर्दिनो विशल्यो वाणवाँ२ उत। अनेशन्नस्य या इषव आभुरस्य निषङ्गधिः॥
verses.tr: vijyaṃ dhanuḥ kapardino viśalyo vāṇavāṃ2 uta aneśannasya yā iṣava ābhurasya niṣaṅgadhiḥ
verses.en: Now stringless be Kapardin's bow, his quiver hold no pointed shaft. The shafts he had have perished and the sheath that held his sword is bare.

verses.sa: या ते हेतिर्मीढुष्टम हस्ते बभूव ते धनुः। तयाऽस्मान्विश्वतस्त्वमयक्ष्मया परि भुज॥
verses.tr: yā te hetirmīḍhuṣṭama haste babhūva te dhanuḥ tayā'smānviśvatastvamayakṣmayā pari bhuja
verses.en: Thy weapon, O Most Bountiful, the bow that resteth in thy hand,—With that, deprived of power to harm, protect thou us on every side.

verses.sa: परि ते धन्वनो हेतिरस्मान्वृणक्तु विश्वतः। अथो य इषुधिस्तवारे अस्मन्नि धेहि तम्॥
verses.tr: pari te dhanvano hetirasmānvṛṇaktu viśvataḥ atho ya iṣudhistavāre asmanni dhehi tam
verses.en: So may the arrow of thy bow, in all directions, pass us by, And in a place remote from us lay thou the quiver that thou hast.

verses.sa: अवतत्य धनुष्ट्वं सहस्राक्ष शतेषुधे। निशीर्य शल्यानां मुखा शिवो नः सुमना भव॥
verses.tr: avatatya dhanuṣṭvaṃ sahasrākṣa śateṣudhe niśīrya śalyānāṃ mukhā śivo naḥ sumanā bhava
verses.en: Having unbent thy bow O thou hundred-eyed, hundred-quivered One! And dulled thy pointed arrows' heads, be kind and gracious unto us.

verses.sa: नमस्त आयुधायानातताय धृष्णवे। उभाभ्यामुत ते नमो बाहुभ्यां तव धन्वने॥
verses.tr: namasta āyudhāyānātatāya dhṛṣṇave ubhābhyāmuta te namo bāhubhyāṃ tava dhanvane
verses.en: To thy fierce weapon, now unstrung, be reverent obeisance paid. Homage be paid to both thine arms, and to thy bow be reverence!

verses.sa: मा नो महान्तमुत मा नो अर्भकं मा न उक्षन्तमुत मा न उक्षितम्। मा नो वधीः पितरं मोत मातरं मा नः प्रियास्तन्वो रुद्र रीरिषः॥
verses.tr: mā no mahāntamuta mā no arbhakaṃ mā na ukṣantamuta mā na ukṣitam mā no vadhīḥ pitaraṃ mota mātaraṃ mā naḥ priyāstanvo rudra rīriṣaḥ
verses.en: Do thou no injury to great or small of us, harm not the growing boy, harm not the full-grown man. Slay not a sire among us, slay no mother here, and to our own dear bodies, Rudra! do no harm.

verses.sa: मा नस्तोके तनये मा न आयुषि मा नो गोषु मा नो अश्वेषु रीरिषः। मा नो वीरान् रुद्र भामिनो वधीर्हविष्मन्तः सदमित् त्वा हवामहे॥
verses.tr: mā nastoke tanaye mā na āyuṣi mā no goṣu mā no aśveṣu rīriṣaḥ mā no vīrān rudra bhāmino vadhīrhaviṣmantaḥ sadamit tvā havāmahe
verses.en: Harm us not in our seed or in our progeny, harm us not in our life or in our cows or steeds. Slay not our heroes in the fury of their wrath. We with oblations ever call on only thee.

verses.sa: नमो हिरण्यबाहवे सेनान्ये दिशां च पतये नमो नमो वृक्षेभ्यो हरिकेशेभ्यः पशूनां पतये नमो नमः शष्पिञ्जराय त्विषीमते पथीनां पतये नमो नमो हरिकेशायोपवीतिने पुष्टानां पतये नमः॥
verses.tr: namo hiraṇyabāhave senānye diśāṃ ca pataye namo namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyaḥ paśūnāṃ pataye namo namaḥ śaṣpiñjarāya tviṣīmate pathīnāṃ pataye namo namo harikeśāyopavītine puṣṭānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the golden-armed leader of hosts, lord of the regions, to the trees with their green tresses, to the Lord of beasts be homage; homage to him whose, sheen is like green grass, homage to the radiant Lord of paths, homage to the golden-haired wearer of the sacrificial cord, homage to the Lord of the well-endowed.

verses.sa: नमो बभ्लुशाय व्याधिने ऽन्नानां पतये नमो नमो भवस्य हेत्यै जगतां पतये नमो नमो रुद्रायाततायिने क्षेत्राणां पतये नमो नमः सूतायाहन्त्यै वनानां पतये नमः॥
verses.tr: namo babhluśāya vyādhine 'nnānāṃ pataye namo namo bhavasya hetyai jagatāṃ pataye namo namo rudrāyātatāyine kṣetrāṇāṃ pataye namo namaḥ sūtāyāhantyai vanānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the brown-hued piercer, to the Lord of food be homage. Homage to Bhava's weapon, homage to the Lord of moving things! Homage to Rudra whose bow is bent to slay, to the Lord of fields homage, homage to be charioteer who injures none, to the Lord of forests be homage.

verses.sa: नमो रोहिताय स्थपतये वृक्षाणां पतये नमो नमो भुवन्तये वारिवस्कृतायौषधीनां पतये नमो नमो मन्त्रिणे वाणिजाय कक्षाणां पतये नमो नम उच्चैर्घोषायाक्रन्दयते पत्तीनां पतये नमः॥
verses.tr: namo rohitāya sthapataye vṛkṣāṇāṃ pataye namo namo bhuvantaye vārivaskṛtāyauṣadhīnāṃ pataye namo namo mantriṇe vāṇijāya kakṣāṇāṃ pataye namo nama uccairghoṣāyākrandayate pattīnāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the red architect, to the Lord of trees homage! Homage to him who stretched out the earth, to him who gives relief be homage. Homage to the Lord of Plants, homage to the prudent merchant! Homage to the Lord of bushes, to the shouting Lord of foot-soldiers who makes foes weep be homage.

verses.sa: नमः कृत्स्नायतया धावते सत्वनां पतये नमो नमः सहमानाय निव्याधिन आव्याधिनीनां पतये नमो नमो निषङ्गिणे ककुभाय स्तेनानां पतये नमो नमो निचेरवे परिचरायारण्यानां पतये नमः॥
verses.tr: namaḥ kṛtsnāyatayā dhāvate satvanāṃ pataye namo namaḥ sahamānāya nivyādhina āvyādhinīnāṃ pataye namo namo niṣaṅgiṇe kakubhāya stenānāṃ pataye namo namo nicerave paricarāyāraṇyānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the runner at full stretch, to the Lord of ministering spirits, homage! Homage to the conquering, piercing Lord of assailing bands, homage to the towering sword-bearer, to the Lord of thieves homage! Homage to the gliding robber, to the roamer, to the Lord of forests homage!

verses.sa: नमो वञ्चते परिवञ्चते स्तायूनां पतये नमो नमो निषङ्गिण इषुधिमते तस्कराणां पतये नमो नमः सृकायिभ्यो जिघांसद्भ्यो मुष्णतां पतये नमो नमोऽसिमद्भ्यो नक्तञ्चरद्भ्यो विकृन्तानां पतये नमः॥
verses.tr: namo vañcate parivañcate stāyūnāṃ pataye namo namo niṣaṅgiṇa iṣudhimate taskarāṇāṃ pataye namo namaḥ sṛkāyibhyo jighāṃsadbhyo muṣṇatāṃ pataye namo namo'simadbhyo naktañcaradbhyo vikṛntānāṃ pataye namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the cheat, to the arch-deceiver, to the Lord of stealers homage! Homage to the wearer of sword and quiver, to the Lord of robbers homage! Homage to the boltarmed homicides, to the Lord of pilferers homage! Homage to the sword-bearers, to those who roam at night, to the Lord of plunderers homage!

verses.sa: नम उष्णीषिणे गिरिचराय कुलुञ्चानां पतये नमो नम इषुमद्भ्यो धन्वायिभ्यश्च वो नमो नम आतन्वानेभ्यः प्रतिदधानेभ्यश्च वो नमो नम आयच्छद्भ्यो ऽस्यद्भ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: nama uṣṇīṣiṇe giricarāya kuluñcānāṃ pataye namo nama iṣumadbhyo dhanvāyibhyaśca vo namo nama ātanvānebhyaḥ pratidadhānebhyaśca vo namo nama āyacchadbhyo 'syadbhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: To the turban-wearing haunter of mountains, Lord of land-grabbers homage! Homage to you who bear arrows and to you who carry bows. Homage to you with bent bows, and to you who adjust your arrows, to you who draw the bow and to you who shoot be homage!

verses.sa: नमो विसृजद्भ्यो विध्यद्भ्यश्च वो नमो नमः स्वपद्भ्यो जाग्रद्भ्यश्च वो नमो नमः शयानेभ्य आसीनेभ्यश्च वो नमो नमस्तिष्ठद्भ्यो धावद्भ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: namo visṛjadbhyo vidhyadbhyaśca vo namo namaḥ svapadbhyo jāgradbhyaśca vo namo namaḥ śayānebhya āsīnebhyaśca vo namo namastiṣṭhadbhyo dhāvadbhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to you who let fly and to you who pierce, homage to you who sleep and to you who wake, homage to you who lie and to you who sit, homage to you who stand and to you who run.

verses.sa: नमः सभाभ्यः सभापतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमोऽश्वेभ्यो ऽश्वपतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नम आव्याधिनीभ्यो विविध्यन्तीभ्यश्च वो नमो नम उगणाभ्यस्तृंहतीभ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: namaḥ sabhābhyaḥ sabhāpatibhyaśca vo namo namo'śvebhyo 'śvapatibhyaśca vo namo nama āvyādhinībhyo vividhyantībhyaśca vo namo nama ugaṇābhyastṛṃhatībhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to assemblies and to you lords of assemblies, homage to horses and to you masters of horses, homage to you hosts that wound and pierce, to you destructive armies with excellent bands be homage.

verses.sa: नमो गणेभ्यो गणपतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो व्रातेभ्यो व्रातपतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो गृत्सेभ्यो गृत्सपतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो विरूपेभ्यो विश्वरूपेभ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: namo gaṇebhyo gaṇapatibhyaśca vo namo namo vrātebhyo vrātapatibhyaśca vo namo namo gṛtsebhyo gṛtsapatibhyaśca vo namo namo virūpebhyo viśvarūpebhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage. Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage. Homage to sharpers and to you the lords of sharpers, homage. Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!

verses.sa: नमः सेनाभ्यः सेनानिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो रथिभ्यो अरतेभ्यश्च वो नमो नमः क्षत्तृभ्यः संग्रहीतृभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो महद्भ्यो अर्भकेभ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: namaḥ senābhyaḥ senānibhyaśca vo namo namo rathibhyo aratebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ kṣattṛbhyaḥ saṃgrahītṛbhyaśca vo namo namo mahadbhyo arbhakebhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage. Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage. Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage. Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.

verses.sa: नमस्तक्षभ्यो रथकारेभ्यश्च वो नमो नमः कुलालेभ्यः कुर्मारेभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो निषादेभ्यः पुञ्जिष्टेभ्यश्च वो नमो नमः श्वनिभ्यो मृगयुभ्यश्च वो नमः॥
verses.tr: namastakṣabhyo rathakārebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ kulālebhyaḥ kurmārebhyaśca vo namo namo niṣādebhyaḥ puñjiṣṭebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ śvanibhyo mṛgayubhyaśca vo namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage. Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage. Homage to you Nishadas and to you Punjishthas, homage. Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.

verses.sa: नमः श्वभ्यः श्वपतिभ्यश्च वो नमो नमो भवाय च रुद्राय च नमः शर्वाय च पशुपतये च नमो नीलग्रीवाय च शितिकण्ठाय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ śvabhyaḥ śvapatibhyaśca vo namo namo bhavāya ca rudrāya ca namaḥ śarvāya ca paśupataye ca namo nīlagrīvāya ca śitikaṇṭhāya ca
verses.en: Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage. Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva and to Pasupati, and to Nilagriva and Sitikantha, homage.

verses.sa: नमः कपर्दिने च व्युप्तकेशाय च नमः सहस्राक्षाय च शतधन्वने च नमो गिरिशयाय च शिपिविष्टाय च नमो मीढुष्टमाय चेषुमते च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ kapardine ca vyuptakeśāya ca namaḥ sahasrākṣāya ca śatadhanvane ca namo giriśayāya ca śipiviṣṭāya ca namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya ceṣumate ca
verses.en: Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven hair, homage! Homage to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows, homage! To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage! To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!

verses.sa: नमो ह्रस्वाय च वामनाय च नमो बृहते च वर्षीयसे च नमो वृद्धाय च सवृधे च नमोऽग्र्याय च प्रथमाय च॥
verses.tr: namo hrasvāya ca vāmanāya ca namo bṛhate ca varṣīyase ca namo vṛddhāya ca savṛdhe ca namo'gryāya ca prathamāya ca
verses.en: Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the fullgrown and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first be homage.

verses.sa: नम आशवे चाजिराय च नमः शीघ्र्याय च शीभ्याय च नम ऊर्म्याय चावस्वन्याय च नमो नादेयाय च द्वीप्याय च॥
verses.tr: nama āśave cājirāya ca namaḥ śīghryāya ca śībhyāya ca nama ūrmyāya cāvasvanyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca dvīpyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to the swift, and to the active be homage, and to the hasty and to the rapid mover be homage! Homage to him who dwells in waves, and in still waters, to him who dwells in rivers and on islands.

verses.sa: नमो ज्येष्ठाय च कनिष्ठाय च नमः पूर्वजाय चापरजाय च नमो मध्यमाय चापगल्भाय च नमो जघन्याय च बुध्न्याय च॥
verses.tr: namo jyeṣṭhāya ca kaniṣṭhāya ca namaḥ pūrvajāya cāparajāya ca namo madhyamāya cāpagalbhāya ca namo jaghanyāya ca budhnyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the firstborn and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who is in the depth, be homage!

verses.sa: नमः सोभ्याय च प्रतिसर्याय च नमो याम्याय च क्षेम्याय च नमः श्लोक्याय चावसान्याय च नम उर्वर्याय च खल्याय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ sobhyāya ca pratisaryāya ca namo yāmyāya ca kṣemyāya ca namaḥ ślokyāya cāvasānyāya ca nama urvaryāya ca khalyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet, homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of the threshing-floor be homage.

verses.sa: नमो वन्याय च कक्ष्याय च नमः श्रवाय च प्रतिश्रवाय च नम आशुषेणाय चाशुरथाय च नमः शूराय चावभेदिने च॥
verses.tr: namo vanyāya ca kakṣyāya ca namaḥ śravāya ca pratiśravāya ca nama āśuṣeṇāya cāśurathāya ca namaḥ śūrāya cāvabhedine ca
verses.en: Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage! Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage! Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who rends asunder be homage.

verses.sa: नमो बिल्मिने च कवचिने च नमो वर्मिणे च वरूथिने च नमः श्रुताय च श्रुतसेनाय च नमो दुन्दुभ्याय चाहनन्याय च॥
verses.tr: namo bilmine ca kavacine ca namo varmiṇe ca varūthine ca namaḥ śrutāya ca śrutasenāya ca namo dundubhyāya cāhananyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears a cuirass, homage! To him who wears mail and defensive armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and to him who makes himself known by beating them.

verses.sa: नमो धृष्णवे च प्रमृशाय च नमो निषङ्गिणे चेषुधिमते च नमस्तीक्ष्णेषवे चायुधिने च नमः स्वायुधाय च सुधन्वने च॥
verses.tr: namo dhṛṣṇave ca pramṛśāya ca namo niṣaṅgiṇe ceṣudhimate ca namastīkṣṇeṣave cāyudhine ca namaḥ svāyudhāya ca sudhanvane ca
verses.en: Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him who hath good weapons and a good bow.

verses.sa: नमः स्रुत्याय च पथ्याय च नमः काट्याय च नीप्याय च नमः कुल्याय च सरस्याय च नमो नादेयाय च वैशन्ताय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ srutyāya ca pathyāya ca namaḥ kāṭyāya ca nīpyāya ca namaḥ kulyāya ca sarasyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca vaiśantāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains, homage to him who dwells in water courses and lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and meres.

verses.sa: नमः कूप्याय चावट्याय च नमो वीध्र्याय चातप्याय च नमो मेघ्याय च च विद्युत्याय च नमो वर्ष्याय चावर्ष्याय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ kūpyāya cāvaṭyāya ca namo vīdhryāya cātapyāya ca namo meghyāya ca ca vidyutyāya ca namo varṣyāya cāvarṣyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.

verses.sa: नमो वात्याय च रेष्म्याय च नमो वास्तव्याय च वास्तुपाय च नमः सोमाय च रुद्राय च नमस्ताम्राय चारुणाय च॥
verses.tr: namo vātyāya ca reṣmyāya ca namo vāstavyāya ca vāstupāya ca namaḥ somāya ca rudrāya ca namastāmrāya cāruṇāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.

verses.sa: नमः शङ्गवे च पशुपतये च नम उग्राय च भीमाय च नमोऽग्रेवधाय च दूरेवधाय च नमो हन्त्रे च हनीयसे च नमो वृक्षेभ्यो हरिकेशेभ्यो नमस्ताराय॥
verses.tr: namaḥ śaṅgave ca paśupataye ca nama ugrāya ca bhīmāya ca namo'grevadhāya ca dūrevadhāya ca namo hantre ca hanīyase ca namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyo namastārāya
verses.en: Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the greentressed trees, homage to the deliverer.

verses.sa: नमः शम्भवाय च मयोभवाय च नमः शङ्कराय च मयस्कराय च नमः शिवाय च शिवतराय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ śambhavāya ca mayobhavāya ca namaḥ śaṅkarāya ca mayaskarāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya ca
verses.en: Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most auspicious.

verses.sa: नमः पार्याय चावार्याय च नमः प्रतरणाय चोत्तरणाय च नमस्तीर्थ्याय च कूल्याय च नमः शष्प्याय च फेन्याय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ pāryāya cāvāryāya ca namaḥ prataraṇāya cottaraṇāya ca namastīrthyāya ca kūlyāya ca namaḥ śaṣpyāya ca phenyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in foam.

verses.sa: नमः सिकत्याय च प्रवाह्याय च नमः किंशिलाय च क्षयणाय च नमः कपर्दिने च पुलस्तये च नम इरिण्याय च प्रपथ्याय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ sikatyāya ca pravāhyāya ca namaḥ kiṃśilāya ca kṣayaṇāya ca namaḥ kapardine ca pulastaye ca nama iriṇyāya ca prapathyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to him who is where still water stands. Homage to him who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth. Homage to him who is in deserts and to him who is on broad roads.

verses.sa: नमो व्रज्याय च गोष्ठ्याय च नमस्तल्प्याय च गेह्याय च नमो हृदय्याय च निवेष्प्याय च नमः काट्याय च गह्वरेष्ठाय च॥
verses.tr: namo vrajyāya ca goṣṭhyāya ca namastalpyāya ca gehyāya ca namo hṛdayyāya ca niveṣpyāya ca namaḥ kāṭyāya ca gahvareṣṭhāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts, and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in wells and to him who is in abysses.

verses.sa: नमः शुष्क्याय च हरित्याय च नमः पांसव्याय च रजस्याय च नमो लोप्याय चोलप्याय च नम ऊर्व्याय च सूर्व्याय च॥
verses.tr: namaḥ śuṣkyāya ca harityāya ca namaḥ pāṃsavyāya ca rajasyāya ca namo lopyāya colapyāya ca nama ūrvyāya ca sūrvyāya ca
verses.en: Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.

verses.sa: नमः पर्णाय च पर्णशदाय च नम उद्गुरमाणाय चाभिघ्नते च नम आखिदते च प्रखिदते च नम इषुकृद्भ्यो धनुष्कृद्भ्यश्च वो नमो नमो वः किरिकेभ्यो देवानां हृदयेभ्यो नमो विचिन्वत्केभ्यो नमो विक्षिणत्केभ्यो नम आनिर्हतेभ्यः॥
verses.tr: namaḥ parṇāya ca parṇaśadāya ca nama udguramāṇāya cābhighnate ca nama ākhidate ca prakhidate ca nama iṣukṛdbhyo dhanuṣkṛdbhyaśca vo namo namo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānāṃ hṛdayebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo namo vikṣiṇatkebhyo nama ānirhatebhyaḥ
verses.en: Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers, to the hearts of the Gods. Homage to the disoerners, homage to the destroyers; homage to the indestructible.

verses.sa: द्रापे अन्धसस्पते दरिद्र नीललोहित। आसां प्रजानामेषां पशूनां मा भेर्मा रोङ्मो च नः किंचनाममत्॥
verses.tr: drāpe andhasaspate daridra nīlalohita āsāṃ prajānāmeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ mā bhermā roṅmo ca naḥ kiṃcanāmamat
verses.en: Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue and red, Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.

verses.sa: इमा रुद्राय तवसे कपर्दिने क्षयद्वीराय प्र भरामहे मतीः। यथा शमसद् द्विपदे चतुष्पदे विश्वं पुष्टं ग्रामे अस्मिन्ननातुरम्॥
verses.tr: imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ yathā śamasad dvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam
verses.en: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.

verses.sa: या ते रुद्र शिवा तनूः शिवा विश्वाहा भेषजी। शिवा रुतस्य भेषजी तया नो मृड जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāhā bheṣajī śivā rutasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase
verses.en: Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth every day, Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.

verses.sa: परि नो रुद्रस्य हेतिर्वृणक्तु परि त्वेषस्य दुर्मतिरघायोः। अव स्थिरा मघवद्भ्यस्तनुष्व मीढ्वस्तोकाय तनयाय मृड॥
verses.tr: pari no rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu pari tveṣasya durmatiraghāyoḥ ava sthirā maghavadbhyastanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḍa
verses.en: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring.

verses.sa: मीढुष्टम शिवतम शिवो नः सुमना भव। परमे वृक्ष आयुधं निधाय कृत्तिं वसान आ चर पिनाकं बिभ्रदा गहि॥
verses.tr: mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama śivo naḥ sumanā bhava parame vṛkṣa āyudhaṃ nidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ā cara pinākaṃ bibhradā gahi
verses.en: Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us. On some remotest tree lay down thy weapon, and clad in robe of skin approach, bearing thy bow come hitherward.

verses.sa: विकिरिद्र विलोहित नमस्ते अस्तु भगवः। यास्ते सहस्रं हेतयोऽन्यमस्मन्नि वपन्तु ताः॥
verses.tr: vikiridra vilohita namaste astu bhagavaḥ yāste sahasraṃ hetayo'nyamasmanni vapantu tāḥ
verses.en: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord? May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.

verses.sa: सहस्राणि सहस्रशो बाह्वोस्तव हेतयः। तासामीशानो भगवः पराचीना मुखा कृधि॥
verses.tr: sahasrāṇi sahasraśo bāhvostava hetayaḥ tāsāmīśāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi
verses.en: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.

verses.sa: असंख्याता सहस्राणि ये रुद्रा अधि भूम्याम्। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.

verses.sa: अस्मिन् महत्यर्णवे ऽन्तरिक्षे भवा अधि। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: asmin mahatyarṇave 'ntarikṣe bhavā adhi teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air. Of all of these do we unbend, etc.

verses.sa: नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठा दिवं रुद्रा उपश्रिताः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.

verses.sa: नीलग्रीवाः शितिकण्ठाः शर्वा अधः क्षमाचराः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhāḥ śarvā adhaḥ kṣamācarāḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.

verses.sa: ये वृक्षेषु शष्पिञ्जरा नीलग्रीवा विलोहिताः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ye vṛkṣeṣu śaṣpiñjarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Those, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.

verses.sa: ये भूतानामधिपतयो विशिखासः कपर्दिनः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ye bhūtānāmadhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Those, ministering spirits lords, with no hair tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.

verses.sa: ये पथां पथिरक्षय ऐलबृदा आयुर्युधः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ye pathāṃ pathirakṣaya ailabṛdā āyuryudhaḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life, Of these, etc.

verses.sa: ये तीर्थानि प्रचरन्ति सृकाहस्ता निषङ्गिणः। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāhastā niṣaṅgiṇaḥ teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with swords, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.

verses.sa: येऽन्नेषु विविध्यन्ति पात्रेषु पिबतो जनान्। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ye'nneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.

verses.sa: य एतावन्तश्च भूयांसश्च दिशो रुद्रा वितस्थिरे। तेषां सहस्रयोजनेऽव धन्वानि तन्मसि॥
verses.tr: ya etāvantaśca bhūyāṃsaśca diśo rudrā vitasthire teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi
verses.en: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.

verses.sa: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये दिवि येषां वर्षमिषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye divi yeṣāṃ varṣamiṣavaḥ tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, tea to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us. Within their jaws we lay the man who hates us and whom we abhor.

verses.sa: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो येऽन्तरिक्षे येषां वात इषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye'ntarikṣe yeṣāṃ vāta iṣavaḥ tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.

verses.sa: नमोऽस्तु रुद्रेभ्यो ये पृथिव्यां येषामन्नमिषवः। तेभ्यो दश प्राचीर्दश दक्षिणा दश प्रतीचीर्दशोदीचीर्दशोर्ध्वाः। तेभ्यो नमो अस्तु ते नोऽवन्तु ते नो मृडयन्तु ते यं द्विष्मो यश्च नो द्वेष्टि तमेषां जम्भे दध्मः॥
verses.tr: namo'stu rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāṃ yeṣāmannamiṣavaḥ tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ
verses.en: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men's food. To them be homage, etc.
